items.summary: In Selby v. United States, Slip Op. 26-142 (Ct. Int'l Trade, Nov. 25, 2026), Judge Jennifer Choe-Groves denied the motion of pro se plaintiff Richard Wayne Selby for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and for court-ordered service. The opinion states that his disclosed take-home pay of $7,032 per month exceeds the federal poverty guideline for a household of three, and that his declaration did not disclose certain cash, assets, other income, and spousal income. The court ordered him to pay the $400.00 filing fee within 30 days, and stated that failure to pay will result in dismissal of the action without prejudice.

items.summary: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is proposing technical updates to the regulations implementing the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) governing hazardous waste treatment, storage, and disposal facilities (TSDFs), as well as associated permitting requirements. The proposal also includes a few conforming technical updates to the generator and transporter regulations. The RCRA hazardous waste TSDF permitting regulations have remained largely unchanged for over three decades, despite evolving standards and practices. Collectively, these revisions are intended to address inadvertent errors, remove obsolete references, reflect current information and standards, and implement targeted updates to the RCRA permitting regulations to improve clarity, consistency, and efficiency in the hazardous waste TSDF permitting program. Through a separate Federal Register document, EPA will be seeking input on areas in the RCRA permitting program and permitting regulations to consider for permitting policy or regulatory reform. items.summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain General Electric Company (GE) Model GE90-110B1 and GE90-115B engines. This proposed AD was prompted by a report of an aborted takeoff due to left engine failure caused by liberation of the interstage high-pressure turbine (HPT) rotor seal rim. This proposed AD would require determining the recalculated service life of the interstage HPT rotor seal and, depending on the results, replacing the interstage HPT rotor seal with a part eligible for installation. For certain engine populations, as an alternative to replacing the interstage HPT rotor seal, this proposed AD would require initial and repetitive ultrasonic inspections of the interstage HPT rotor seal for cracks and, depending on the results, removing the interstage HPT rotor seal from service. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

items.opening_verbatim: Title 3— The President Memorandum of November 23, 2026 Expeditious Enforcement of Capital Sentences and the Pursuit of Justice for Victims of Heinous Crimes Memorandum for the Attorney General By the authority vested in me as President by t
items.summary: A Presidential Memorandum dated November 23, 2026, addressed to the Attorney General, directs the Department of Justice to pursue federal jurisdiction and seek the death penalty, when appropriate and consistent with applicable law, for specified federal capital crimes in addition to those identified in section 3(b) of Executive Order 14164. These crimes include murder in the first degree of a minor, murder committed in the course of rape, sexual abuse, sexual exploitation of a child, or sex trafficking, and murder committed in the course of kidnapping or human trafficking. The memorandum also directs the Attorney General to take lawful measures to carry out federally imposed death sentences as expeditiously as possible, including prioritizing direct appeals, habeas corpus petitions, and other post-conviction proceedings, opposing dilatory litigation tactics, and eliminating unnecessary administrative delays. It states that it is to be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to appropriations, creates no enforceable rights, and that the Department of Justice bears its publication costs.
items.title: Expeditious Enforcement of Capital Sentences and the Pursuit of Justice for Victims of Heinous Crimes
